newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangshen slips 5.7 pct after results.
newsitem.headline: Guangshen slips 5.7 pct after results.

text.p: Shares of Guangshen Railway Co Ltd fell 5.7 percent in Wednesday afternoon trade after the Chinese railway operator announced an interim net profit which was slightly below expectation, brokers said.
The counter fell HK$0.175 to HK$2.875 on volume of 1.83 million shares worth HK$5.5 million in early afternoon trade.
"People were already prepared for poor H shares results but Guangshen was a bit below expectations," a broker said.
But selling pressure was not heavy on fears of further depressing prices although sentiment was weak, brokers said.
Guangshen earlier reported a 21.2 percent drop on interim net to 510.15 million yuan.
